summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Calamos Nasdaq-100 Structured Alt Protection ETF - March (CPNM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (QQQ), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure CPNM was launched on Mar 3, 2025 and is issued by Calamos.
